```{r helper-functions}
# Extract legend from a ggplot for shared legend in combined figures
g_legend <- function(a.gplot) {
  tmp <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(a.gplot))
  leg <- which(sapply(tmp$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
  tmp$grobs[[leg]]
}
```

# Step 1: Data Loading and Cleaning

```{r load-data}
# Set this to the folder containing all 25 participant CSV files
data_dir <- "/Users/rebeccapizzitola/Documents/GitHub/ling-245b-project/replication/data/fullSample"

# Read and combine all CSV files
raw_data <- list.files(
  path       = data_dir,
  pattern    = "^exp1_.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  lapply(read_csv, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  bind_rows()

# Coerce columns to appropriate types
# Note: use .data$rt to avoid collision with base R's rt() function
raw_data <- raw_data |>
  mutate(
    rt           = as.numeric(.data$rt),
    correct      = as.logical(.data$correct),
    is_novel     = as.logical(.data$is_novel),
    chose_nup    = as.numeric(.data$chose_nup),
    chose_norl   = as.numeric(.data$chose_norl),
    points_total = as.numeric(.data$points_total)
  )

cat("Total rows loaded:", nrow(raw_data), "\n")
cat("Participants found:", n_distinct(raw_data$subject_id, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Conditions:", paste(unique(na.omit(raw_data$condition)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r participant-scores}
# Compute each participant's final score as the maximum points_total
# reached during stage1/stage2 forced_choice trials
participant_scores <- raw_data |>
  filter(task == "forced_choice", !is.na(points_total)) |>
  group_by(subject_id) |>
  summarise(score = max(points_total), .groups = "drop")

# Compute each participant's total experiment duration in minutes
# (time_elapsed is in milliseconds; take the max value per participant)
participant_duration <- raw_data |>
  mutate(time_elapsed = as.numeric(time_elapsed)) |>
  group_by(subject_id) |>
  summarise(duration_min = max(time_elapsed, na.rm = TRUE) / 60000, .groups = "drop")

# Build a participant-level summary table
participant_info <- raw_data |>
  filter(!is.na(subject_id)) |>
  distinct(subject_id, condition) |>
  left_join(participant_scores,  by = "subject_id") |>
  left_join(participant_duration, by = "subject_id")

cat("Participants per condition:\n")
print(count(participant_info, condition))

cat("\nScore summary:\n")
print(summary(participant_info$score))

cat("\nDuration summary (minutes):\n")
print(summary(participant_info$duration_min))
```

```{r filter-test-trials}
# --- Suffix selection trials ---
# Rows where task == "suffix_selection"
# Key columns:
#   species       -> CriticalStimuli (alien shown: Norl or Gulu)
#   chose_nup     -> response (1 = nup, 0 = dup)
#   is_novel      -> novelty (TRUE = unseen word, FALSE = seen word)
#   word_root     -> random effect
#   subject_id    -> random effect
#   condition     -> fixed effect

suffix_data <- raw_data |>
  filter(task == "suffix_selection") |>
  select(subject_id, condition, word_root, is_novel,
         critical_stimuli = species,
         chose_nup, correct) |>
  mutate(
    is_novel         = ifelse(is_novel, "unseen", "seen"),
    critical_stimuli = as.factor(critical_stimuli),
    critical_stimuli = relevel(critical_stimuli, ref = "Norl"),
    condition        = as.factor(condition),
    condition        = relevel(condition, ref = "NoExposure"),
    chose_nup        = as.numeric(chose_nup)
  )

cat("Suffix selection trials:", nrow(suffix_data), "\n")
cat("Participants:", n_distinct(suffix_data$subject_id), "\n")


# --- Alien selection trials ---
# Rows where task == "alien_selection"
# Key columns:
#   suffix_shown  -> CriticalStimuli (suffix shown: dup or nup)
#   chose_norl    -> response (1 = Norl, 0 = Gulu)
#   is_novel      -> novelty
#   word_root     -> random effect

alien_data <- raw_data |>
  filter(task == "alien_selection") |>
  select(subject_id, condition, word_root, is_novel,
         critical_stimuli = suffix_shown,
         chose_norl, correct) |>
  mutate(
    is_novel         = ifelse(is_novel, "unseen", "seen"),
    critical_stimuli = as.factor(critical_stimuli),
    critical_stimuli = relevel(critical_stimuli, ref = "dup"),
    condition        = as.factor(condition),
    condition        = relevel(condition, ref = "NoExposure"),
    chose_norl       = as.numeric(chose_norl)
  )

cat("Alien selection trials:", nrow(alien_data), "\n")
cat("Participants:", n_distinct(alien_data$subject_id), "\n")
```

# Step 3: Main Results (Figures 3 & 4)

```{r suffix-plot}
# Compute per-participant nup rate by alien (Norl/Gulu) for suffix selection.
# Each participant saw 38 trials per alien (76 total), matching the original's
# denominator of 38.
suffix_plot_data <- suffix_data |>
  group_by(subject_id, condition, critical_stimuli) |>
  summarise(
    nup_count = sum(chose_nup, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_trials  = n(),
    nup_rate  = nup_count / 38,   # fixed denominator per original script
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

fig3 <- ggplot(suffix_plot_data,
               aes(x = critical_stimuli, y = nup_rate,
                   group = condition, fill = condition, color = condition)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar",
               width = 0.2, fun.args = list(conf.int = 0.95),
               color = "black", position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  labs(x = "Alien stimulus in suffix selection",
       y = "Probability of a nup response") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Exposure" = "#999999", "NoExposure" = "#999999")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Exposure" = "#999999", "NoExposure" = "white")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal")

fig3
```

```{r alien-plot}
# Compute per-participant Norl rate by suffix (dup/nup) for alien selection.
# Each participant saw 19-20 trials per suffix (38 total); original used 20
# as denominator.
alien_plot_data <- alien_data |>
  group_by(subject_id, condition, critical_stimuli) |>
  summarise(
    norl_count = sum(chose_norl, na.rm = TRUE),
    norl_rate  = norl_count / 20,   # fixed denominator per original script
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

fig4 <- ggplot(alien_plot_data,
               aes(x = critical_stimuli, y = norl_rate,
                   group = interaction(critical_stimuli, condition),
                   fill = condition, color = condition)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar",
               width = 0.2, fun.args = list(conf.int = 0.95),
               color = "black", position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  labs(x = "Suffix stimulus in alien selection",
       y = "Probability of a Norl response") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Exposure" = "#999999", "NoExposure" = "#999999")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Exposure" = "#999999", "NoExposure" = "white")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal")

fig4
```

# Step 4: Mixed-Effects Models (Table 2)

```{r model-suffix}
# Logistic GLMM for suffix selection
# DV:       chose_nup (1 = nup, 0 = dup)
# Fixed:    critical_stimuli (Norl ref) * condition (NoExposure ref)
# Random:   (1 | word_root) + (1 | subject_id)

model_suffix <- glmer(
  chose_nup ~ critical_stimuli * condition + (1 | word_root) + (1 | subject_id),
  family = binomial,
  data   = suffix_data
)

summary(model_suffix)
```

```{r model-alien}
# Logistic GLMM for alien selection
# DV:       chose_norl (1 = Norl, 0 = Gulu)
# Fixed:    critical_stimuli (dup ref) * condition (NoExposure ref)
# Random:   (1 | word_root) + (1 | subject_id)

model_alien <- glmer(
  chose_norl ~ critical_stimuli * condition + (1 | word_root) + (1 | subject_id),
  family = binomial,
  data   = alien_data
)

summary(model_alien)
```

```{r model-suffix-novelty}
# Appendix: suffix model with novelty as additional predictor
# novelty: "seen" (ref) vs "unseen"

suffix_data <- suffix_data |>
  mutate(is_novel = relevel(as.factor(is_novel), ref = "seen"))

model_suffix_novelty <- glmer(
  chose_nup ~ critical_stimuli * condition * is_novel + (1 | word_root) + (1 | subject_id),
  family = binomial,
  data   = suffix_data
)

summary(model_suffix_novelty)
```

```{r model-alien-novelty}
# Appendix: alien model with novelty as additional predictor

alien_data <- alien_data |>
  mutate(is_novel = relevel(as.factor(is_novel), ref = "seen"))

model_alien_novelty <- glmer(
  chose_norl ~ critical_stimuli * condition * is_novel + (1 | word_root) + (1 | subject_id),
  family = binomial,
  data   = alien_data
)

summary(model_alien_novelty)
```
